evidence.supportingUpdates: DB59: check-vndb-supporting-updates.ts passed 259 rollback assertions across eight support families plus assembled staff/producer/character dump surfaces and three apply/withdraw/reapply cycles per case. evidence.correspondence: DB57: check-source-child-correspondence.ts passed 21 rollback assertions. The same archived snapshot maps through distinct name/context/scalar epochs after A-to-B-to-A rebind and mapper protocol change; policy revisions retain their epoch. Shared baseline and fact-support epoch integration was applied and checked in DB58.
evidence.protocolRefresh: DB59: check-vndb-protocol-refresh.ts passed 47 rollback assertions for actual v2-to-v3-to-v4 proposal apply/withdraw/reapply. Old unchanged source graph retires, new epoch graph is native, exact old graph/title claims restore, human name/description survive both upgrades, typed pure source interpretation remains source-authored, and a conflicting subsequent scalar source update rejects atomically.
